About us

Carlton Hair salons began in 1968 with a vision to set ourselves apart – higher standards of hairdressing, satisfied clients and passionate stylists. We realise that our success will be determined primarily by the experience each client has with our company. Our strong and visionary management team is continuously building a fashion-orientated company that will always be the performance leader in the hairdressing industry. We are a dynamic and well established company which enjoys a reputation as an innovative company. We pride ourselves in being in touch with the latest trends in beauty, fashions, equipment and technology. Today with 21 salons situated in all major upmarket shopping centres in major cities across South Africa, Carlton Hair salons is recognised as the leading hairdressing company, and a retailer of unique, premium sustainable products.
